description: This file contains functions for parsing user agent strings to determine platform, OS, browser, and application version information, specifically tailored for Mattermost client identification.

methods.name: getPlatformName
methods.description: Determines the platform name based on user agent data and string content.

methods.name: getOSName
methods.description: Returns the OS name based on user agent data and string content.

methods.name: GetDesktopAppVersion
methods.description: Extracts the desktop application version from the user agent string.

methods.name: getBrowserVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the browser version from user agent data and string content.

methods.name: limitStringLength
methods.description: Limits the length of a string to prevent potential issues.

methods.name: getUAVersion
methods.description: Formats the user agent version string from version components.

methods.name: getBrowserName
methods.description: Determines the browser name based on user agent data and string content.
